DEF SIMPLE_FUNCTION(X: INT, Y: INT) -> INT:
    """CALCULATE SUM OF TWO INTEGERS."""
    RETURN X + Y


ASYNC DEF ASYNC_FETCH_DATA(URL: STR) -> DICT:
    """ASYNC FUNCTION TO FETCH DATA FROM URL."""
    IMPORT ASYNCIO

        SELF.DATA.APPEND(ITEM.UPPER())
